findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded in non-controller code paths
findings.body: The new ensure_loaded! method only loads fallback locales when ApplicationController#set_locale explicitly calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. Background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and other non-controller code call I18n.translate directly; translate_accelerator's translate method only loads config.locale before looking up the key. With the new fallback chain [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en], a job using a non-English locale can therefore miss fallback translations that exist in the site-default or English locale, producing missing translation errors or empty/fallback text in emails and jobs.

findings.title: Translation cache key omits dynamic fallback order
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] now makes fallback resolution depend on mutable SiteSetting.default_locale. translate caches results using only key, config.locale, and backend.object_id, so if the site default locale is changed at runtime, entries cached when a key fell back to the old default or :en will continue to be served for the same locale until LRU eviction, even if the new fallback chain would resolve to a different translation.

findings.title: No tests cover the fallback setup
findings.body: The PR replaces per-environment config.i18n.fallbacks with a custom fallback chain and lazy loading, but adds no tests. There is no coverage that a non-English locale falls back to SiteSetting.default_locale and then :en, that fallback locales are loaded in all relevant entry points, or that runtime changes to default_locale do not leave stale accelerator cache entries.
